Box

The surface primitive. A block with token-valued padding, background, border and radius — the only way a layout gets a background or an inset without a component of its own.

Basic usage

Install the package:

pnpm add @design-schema/react

Import the stylesheet once for the app, then the component:

import '@design-schema/react/index.css';
import { Box } from '@design-schema/react';

Examples

A panel of settings
import { Box, Text } from '@design-schema/react';

<Box inset="md" surface="subtle" radius="md">{typeof 'A panel of settings' === 'string' ? <Text>{'A panel of settings'}</Text> : 'A panel of settings'}</Box>

Props

8 rows
PropTypeDefaultDescriptionPlatforms
children requiredcontent—

Any content. Box does not space its children; put a Stack inside for that. A string given as `children` in an example is wrapped in the system Text by its story on every platform (`<ds-text>` on Lit, where slotted content cannot be an arg): one meta-level render wraps only string children in a Text at its defaults, so each example story keeps exactly its `given` as args. The Default story uses the `highlighted-panel` props, since a Box at its schema defaults draws nothing; meta args may still list the schema defaults (`border: false`, `element: div`) as controls. Behavior scenarios render the Default story's args with their `given` on top, which is intended: they assert only renders and roles.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
insetnone | sm | md | lg | xlnone

Padding on all sides, from the layout inset presets. Use `insetBlock`/`insetInline` when the axes differ.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
insetBlocknone | sm | md | lg | xl—

Vertical padding, overriding `inset` on that axis. It has no default: unset means `inset` applies, which keeps an explicit `none` distinct from an absent value.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
insetInlinenone | sm | md | lg | xl—

Horizontal padding, overriding `inset` on that axis. Unset means `inset` applies, as with insetBlock.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
surfacenone | default | subtle | strongnone

Background. `none` is transparent; `default` is the page background (use to lift content off a subtle parent); `subtle` and `strong` step up.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
borderbooleanfalse

A thin default border.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
radiusnone | sm | md | lg | fullnone

Corner radius from the theme's presets.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
elementdiv | section | article | aside | header | footer | main | navdiv

Element to render. Sectioning elements only when the box is a semantic region; prefer Landmark for page regions. There is no native counterpart, so a screen that ports to React Native uses Landmark for the region instead of this prop.

web, lit

Accessibility

No implicit ARIA role — the component is styling and structure, and adds nothing to the accessibility tree.

surface
